nodes.label: PHA/PLA/microcellulose films as polypropylene substitute for food packaging
nodes.author: Sierra Avila Cesar Augusto

nodes.label: PHA/PLA/MC biodegradable blend
nodes.rationale: PHA is thermally unstable and rigid, so PLA adds plasticity and thermal resistance, and microcellulose improves mechanical properties acting as adhesive between polymers.
